reason_for_revision: The prior v3_sparse_m3_frozen development anchor applied weights and affine calibration selected on 2024 retroactively to 2022 and 2023. This made upward-mean candidate directions look falsely stable.

supersedes.scope: only historical-baseline construction and the definition of score deltas in V5 contract v1

folds.F_regime_rule: Primary transfer gates use R. F must remain an unchanged parent prediction or use a separately preregistered post-break recipe.

same_parent_gate.definition: A feature/model ablation is first compared with the exact parent recipe on every target fold, with all training data, seeds, features and routing other than the preregistered change held fixed.
requirements: positive R point gain in both 2022 and 2023
positive pitcher-cluster 95% R gain lower bound in both 2022 and 2023
recipe and any blend coefficient locked before reading 2024
positive 2024 R point gain and positive pitcher-cluster 95% R gain lower bound

honest_anchors.target_rule: For target season Y, select all meta parameters using season Y-1 only and transfer them unchanged to Y.
honest_anchors.published_v3_role: v3_sparse_m3_frozen is retained as the actual 1090.9100565103 leaderboard deployment reference, not as the historical development anchor.

eligible_without_actual_lb: at most three nonnegative components whose fixed weights sum to one
ineligible_without_actual_lb: conditional gates fitted on the confirmation fold

conservative_score.G_dev: minimum full-score gain over 2022 and 2023 across the exact-parent comparison and both required honest anchors
conservative_score.G_confirm: minimum locked 2024 full-score point gain across the exact-parent comparison and both required honest anchors
conservative_score.G_ci: minimum locked 2024 pitcher-cluster 95% full-score gain lower bound across the exact-parent comparison and both required honest anchors
